name: University of Kentucky
academic_ranking: Public land-grant research university (Carnegie R1). U.S. News & World Report (2025): #152 national universities, #81 among public universities. Comprises 16 colleges with ~35,900 students (fall 2024).
financial_aid: Out-of-state undergraduate tuition and fees ~$35,846 for 2026-27; in-state ~$14,178 (figures include mandatory fees, full-time enrollment). Financial aid administered by the Office of Student Financial Aid & Scholarships (OSFAS@uky.edu, (859) 257-3172); FAFSA school code 001989. Athletic scholarships available for softball as an NCAA D1 head-count/equivalency sport.
facilities_notes: Kentucky softball plays at John Cropp Stadium, a $9.5 million facility that debuted for the 2013 season. The program has hosted the SEC Tournament and multiple NCAA regionals (2013, 2014, 2016-2018).
program_reputation: Established NCAA Division I SEC softball program. Regular NCAA Tournament participant, having hosted NCAA regionals multiple times at John Cropp Stadium. Competes in the Southeastern Conference, one of the strongest softball conferences nationally.
notes: Data gathered live from the UK Athletics staff directory (staff-directory), softball roster page, and University of Kentucky financial/academic sources on 2026-07-30. Roster size (23) reflects the 2026-27 softball roster. Coaching staff emails route to a shared program address (kentuckysoftball@uky.edu); no individual public emails or Twitter/X handles were listed for coaches in the staff directory.
